business_summary: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a reinsurance company in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company operates through Property and Casualty Reinsurance, Life and Health Reinsurance, Primary Property and Casualty Insurance, Asset Management, and Other segments. It offers reinsurance products, including motor, commercial and household property, engineering, marine hull, liability, credit and guarantee, health, agriculture, space and aviation, energy, nuclear, etc.; and insurance agency services, such as risk identification, assessment and consulting, insurance program design, insurance procurement, insurance policy management, claim management, disaster and accident prevention management, overall risk management, and reinsurance arrangement products. The company also provides specialty insurance, asset management, insurance brokerage, risk evaluation and management, underwriting agency, information technology, risk advisory, management consulting, and investment management services, as well as issues bonds. In addition, it is involved in the e-commerce business; management of insurance; and provision of multi-asset investment products, such as project-based financing programs, asset-backed securities, infrastructure investment programs, and real estate investment programs. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation은 자회사와 함께 중화인민공화국 및 해외에서 재보험 회사로 활동하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 재산 및 상해 재보험, 생명 및 건강 재보험, 주요 재산 및 상해 보험, 자산 관리 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 자동차, 상업 및 가계 재산, 엔지니어링, 해양 선체, 책임, 신용 및 보증, 건강, 농업, 우주 및 항공, 에너지, 원자력 등을 포함한 재보험 상품을 제공합니다. 위험 식별, 평가 및 컨설팅, 보험 프로그램 설계, 보험 조달, 보험 정책 관리, 청구 관리, 재해 및 사고 예방 관리, 전반적인 위험 관리 및 재보험 주선 상품과 같은 보험 대행사 서비스. 또한 전문 보험, 자산 관리, 보험 중개, 위험 평가 및 관리, 보험 인수 대행, 정보 기술, 위험 자문, 경영 컨설팅, 투자 관리 서비스를 제공하고 채권을 발행합니다. 또한 전자상거래 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 보험 관리; 및 Multi-asse 제공
